corpus: All customer communications shall be reviewed within 24 hours — FINRA Rule 3110. Firms shall retain records of communications for not less than three years — SEC Rule 17a-4. Banking entities shall not engage in proprietary trading — Dodd-Frank Volcker Rule 12 USC 1851. Audit records shall be retained for not less than seven years — Sarbanes-Oxley Section 802. Electronic protected health information must be access-controlled — HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312. Consumers may request deletion of personal information — CCPA Cal. Civ. Code 1798.105. Financial institutions shall safeguard customer information — GLBA 15 USC 6801. Know-your-customer verification is required before account opening — BSA 31 USC 5318. Consumer complaints must be logged — CFPB 12 CFR 1002. Anti-money-laundering checks apply to transactions above reporting thresholds — 31 CFR 1010. Foreign corrupt practices are prohibited for issuers and domestic concerns — FCPA 15 USC 78dd-1. Personal data must be erased upon request within thirty days — GDPR Article 17. Investment firms must assess client suitability — MiFID II Article 25. Strong customer authentication is required for electronic payments — PSD2 Article 97. Financial entities shall manage ICT risk frameworks — DORA Article 6. Enhanced due diligence is required for high-risk third-country relationships — 4AMLD/5AMLD. Data controllers must report breaches within seventy-two hours — UK GDPR Article 33. Firms must maintain effective compliance arrangements — FCA SYSC 6. Commercial organisations must prevent bribery — UK Bribery Act 2010 Section 7. Senior managers must be certified as fit and proper annually — SMCR. Les entreprises doivent prévenir la corruption — Loi Sapin II Article 17. No person shall employ any device to defraud in connection with the sale of a security — SEC Rule 10b-5. Broker-dealers must maintain minimum net capital — SEC Rule 15c3-1. Banks must file currency transaction reports for cash exceeding thresholds — 31 CFR 1010.311. The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures — GDPR Article 24. Every insurer shall maintain a risk management framework — Solvency II Directive. Credit institutions shall hold a capital conservation buffer — CRD IV Article 129. Firms must conduct regular stress testing of their portfolios — Basel III Pillar 2. Companies must disclose material cybersecurity incidents within four business days — SEC 17 CFR 229.106. Public companies shall maintain internal controls over financial reporting — SOX Section 404. Every market participant must report suspicious transactions without delay — EU MAR Article 16. Organizations must appoint a Data Protection Officer where required — GDPR Article 37. Financial services firms must treat customers fairly at all times — FCA Principle 6. Creditors must assess ability to repay — Truth in Lending Act 15 USC 1639c. Equal credit opportunity must be afforded without discrimination — ECOA Regulation B 12 CFR 1002.4. Debt collectors may not use abusive practices — FDCPA 15 USC 1692d. Every deficiency claim must provide an accounting — UCC Article 9. Notice of right to redeem must be provided before disposal of collateral — UCC 9-623. Overtime compensation at one and one-half times the regular rate — FLSA 29 USC 207. Digital operational resilience testing must be conducted at least annually — DORA Article 24. Algorithmic trading firms must have effective systems and risk controls — MiFID II Article 17. Issuers must disclose inside information as soon as possible — MAR Article 17. Transfers of personal data to third countries require adequate safeguards — GDPR Article 46. Controllers must conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments for high-risk processing — GDPR Article 35. Servicers must provide accurate periodic statements — RESPA Regulation X 12 CFR 1024.17. Lenders must provide a Loan Estimate within three business days of application — TRID 12 CFR 1026.19. Collection agencies must validate debts within five days of initial communication — FDCPA 15 USC 1692g. Employers must maintain records of hours worked and wages paid — FLSA 29 USC 211. Cross-border data transfers require binding corporate rules or standard contractual clauses — GDPR Article 46. Third-party ICT service providers must be monitored on an ongoing basis — DORA Article 28. Persons discharging managerial responsibilities must notify transactions — EU MAR Article 19. Payment service providers must ensure operational resilience — PSD2 Article 95. Data processors must only act on documented instructions from the controller — GDPR Article 28.
